title: Why does AI love the em dash — so much?

beats.say: Why is AI obsessed with this little line?

beats.sub: many now see it as a sign of AI text
beats.say: It's called the em dash. And chatbots can't stop using it.

beats.big:
Most people
can't even
type one.
beats.say: Most people can't even find it on their keyboard.
One theory: old books. AI labs fed their models huge piles of digitized print books.
Moby Dick alone has one thousand seven hundred twenty eight em dashes.

beats.sub: em dash use in books, reportedly
beats.say: Books from the early nineteen hundreds reportedly use about thirty percent more of them than writing today.

beats.sub: a robot with a Victorian habit
beats.say: So your futuristic chatbot may be writing like it's nineteen hundred.
